title: Artemis II product filename (still image, audio or annotation NASA ID)
reference: Artemis II Science Data User Guide (Artemis II archive SIS), v1.0-R1, Appendix D (File Naming Convention, Table 21)

segments.label: Mission
segments.description: Artemis II prefix. On products with a NASA ID it opens the ID assigned by NASA Johnson Space Center Imagery Online, the permanent identifier for Artemis II data across NASA data-serving systems.

segments.label: Media type
segments.description: Kind of media the NASA ID was assigned to.

segments.label: Sequence number
segments.description: Sequential six-digit NASA ID number. It is the order in which JSC received and catalogued the files, not necessarily the order they were recorded; use the label's start_date_time for time order.

segments.label: Last NASA ID
segments.description: Appended to a PCD annotation document to give the NASA ID of its last page; the leading ID is that of the first page.

segments.label: Instrument
segments.description: Camera, device or sensor that produced the data. Some crew annotation documents carry no instrument ID.

NKD5015.description: Crew handheld DSLR, paired with the 80–400 mm Long Lens for about 98% of its science images.

NKD5017.description: Crew handheld DSLR, paired with the 12–24 mm Short Lens for about 57% of its science images and the Long Lens for 29%.

NKZ9019.description: Crew handheld mirrorless camera, paired with a 35 mm lens for 74% of its science images; the primary camera for the eclipse observations during the lunar flyby. Records NEF in the High Efficiency star (HE*) format.

SAW2.description: Modified GoPro Hero 4 Black mounted at the end of Orion solar array wing 2.

SAW3.description: Modified GoPro Hero 4 Black mounted at the end of Orion solar array wing 3; the primary vehicle camera for stills and video during the lunar flyby.

SAW4.description: Modified GoPro Hero 4 Black mounted at the end of Orion solar array wing 4.

CAB2.description: GoPro Hero 4 Black mounted inside forward Window 3, capturing the crew's perspective.

ONAV.description: Pixelink Prometheus PL-D725MU monochrome camera; primarily supported Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) activities.

DCAM.description: Malin Space Science Systems custom monochrome CMOS camera; primarily supported Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC) activities.

PCD.description: Portable Computing Device (Microsoft Surface Pro 5) used to record crew audio with a Peltor headset, record handwritten notes, relay imagery for downlink and carry the Lunar Targeting Plan.

PCD1.description: CDR Wiseman's primary PCD; shared with MS1 Koch after the PCD 4 failure.

PCD2.description: PLT Glover's primary PCD; recorded audio of Hansen and Glover during the lunar flyby.

PCD3.description: MS2 Hansen's primary PCD; recorded audio of Koch and Wiseman during the lunar flyby.

PCD4.description: MS1 Koch's primary PCD; failed part-way through the mission.

segments.label: Product type
segments.description: Processing level or type of product.

SRC.meaning: Source — original data, no format conversion
SRC.description: Original data from the camera or instrument with no format conversion applied (not a standard PDS4 processing level). Nikon NEF files are archived as native products; Orion camera JPEG and PNG originals as browse products.

RAW.meaning: Raw — converted to a PDS4-compliant format
RAW.description: Data as received from the system, converted to a PDS-approved format where required (Nikon NEF to TIFF, Orion JPEG/PNG to TIFF, voice-loop MP3 to M4A).

PRC.description: Nikon images demosaiced from NEF to 16-bit TIFF with Nikon NX Studio (Original Camera Settings, sRGB, autoscaling); no calibration applied. The PNG of a processed image is its 8-bit browse product.

TRN-CSV.description: Derived transcript of a PCD or voice-loop recording, generated with whisperX and checked by the Lunar Science Team; columns are audio elapsed time, UTC time, speaker and text.

TRN-SRT.description: Derived transcript of a PCD or voice-loop recording in SubRip subtitle form, generated with whisperX and checked by the Lunar Science Team.

ANN.description: Crew handwritten annotations made in OneNote on a PCD, converted from the downlinked .one file to PDF/A.

segments.label: Version
segments.description: Two-digit major version number. A change in data warrants a major version change; a change in metadata only is a minor change.

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: File format. Still images are .tif (PDS4) with .nef, .jpg or .png source originals and .png browse; PCD audio is .m4a; transcripts .csv and .srt; annotations .pdf. Every product has a detached .xml label of the same name.

values.NEF: Nikon Electronic Format — native source image from the crew Nikon D5 (14-bit lossless NEF) or Z9 (NEF HE*) cameras
values.TIF: Uncompressed TIFF — PDS4 raw or processed image array
values.JPG: Original source JPEG from an Orion GoPro camera (SAW Cam 2–4, Cab Cam 2), archived as a browse product
values.PNG: PNG — browse image of a processed Nikon TIFF, or an original Orion DCAM/OpNav or iPhone image
values.M4A: M4A (AAC) audio — PCD recording or voice-loop audio
values.CSV: Comma-delimited table — audio transcript or HOBO data-logger record
values.PDF: PDF/A document — crew annotations or mission documentation

title: Artemis II video filename (NASA ID)
reference: Artemis II Science Data User Guide (Artemis II archive SIS), v1.0-R1, Appendix D (File Naming Convention, Table 21)

segments.label: Mission
segments.description: Artemis II prefix. On products with a NASA ID it opens the ID assigned by NASA Johnson Space Center Imagery Online, the permanent identifier for Artemis II data across NASA data-serving systems.

segments.label: Media type
segments.description: Kind of media the NASA ID was assigned to.

segments.label: Video channel
segments.description: Video channel, the first three digits of the ten-digit video NASA ID. SAW Cam 3 video was recorded at JSC on two separate downlink decoders; both copies are archived (channel1 and channel2).

segments.label: UTC day of year
segments.description: UTC day of year of the recording.

segments.label: UTC time
segments.description: UTC hour and minute of the recording.

segments.label: Instrument
segments.description: Orion camera that produced the video.

SAW3.description: Modified GoPro Hero 4 Black on solar array wing 3; streamed video in real time during the lunar flyby.

segments.label: Product type
segments.description: Processing level or type of product.

VID.description: SAW Cam 3 video, converted from the ground-recorded MXF streams to H.264 MP4.

RAW.meaning: Raw — converted to a PDS4-compliant format
RAW.description: Data as received from the system, converted to a PDS-approved format where required (Nikon NEF to TIFF, Orion JPEG/PNG to TIFF, voice-loop MP3 to M4A).

segments.label: Version
segments.description: Two-digit major version number. A change in data warrants a major version change; a change in metadata only is a minor change.

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: File format. Video is H.264 .mp4 (PDS4) with a detached .xml label.

values.MP4: MP4 — H.264 video (SAW Cam 3) or voice-loop audio

title: Artemis II voice loop filename
reference: Artemis II Science Data User Guide (Artemis II archive SIS), v1.0-R1, Appendix D (File Naming Convention, Table 21)

segments.label: Mission
segments.description: Artemis II prefix. On products with a NASA ID it opens the ID assigned by NASA Johnson Space Center Imagery Online, the permanent identifier for Artemis II data across NASA data-serving systems.

segments.label: UTC date
segments.description: UTC day covered. Voice-loop audio was split into files by UTC day; files without a NASA ID carry the date instead.

segments.label: Instrument
segments.description: Houston voice loop between the crew and JSC mission control.

OE1.description: Primary crew-to-mission-control loop, publicly aired during NASA video streams.

OE2.description: Used sparingly during loss of signal on O/E-1.

segments.label: Product type
segments.description: Processing level or type of product.

RAW.meaning: Raw — converted to a PDS4-compliant format
RAW.description: Data as received from the system, converted to a PDS-approved format where required (Nikon NEF to TIFF, Orion JPEG/PNG to TIFF, voice-loop MP3 to M4A).

TRN-CSV.description: Derived transcript of a PCD or voice-loop recording, generated with whisperX and checked by the Lunar Science Team; columns are audio elapsed time, UTC time, speaker and text.

TRN-SRT.description: Derived transcript of a PCD or voice-loop recording in SubRip subtitle form, generated with whisperX and checked by the Lunar Science Team.

segments.label: Version
segments.description: Two-digit major version number. A change in data warrants a major version change; a change in metadata only is a minor change.

segments.label: Extension
segments.description: File format. Voice-loop audio (received as MP3) is archived as .m4a/.mp4; transcripts as .csv and .srt. Every product has a detached .xml label.

values.M4A: M4A (AAC) audio — PCD recording or voice-loop audio
values.MP4: MP4 — H.264 video (SAW Cam 3) or voice-loop audio
values.CSV: Comma-delimited table — audio transcript or HOBO data-logger record

title: Artemis II HOBO data logger filename
reference: Artemis II Science Data User Guide (Artemis II archive SIS), v1.0-R1, Appendix D (File Naming Convention, Table 21)

segments.label: Mission
segments.description: Artemis II prefix. On products with a NASA ID it opens the ID assigned by NASA Johnson Space Center Imagery Online, the permanent identifier for Artemis II data across NASA data-serving systems.

segments.label: UTC start
segments.description: UTC start of the logged record, as day of year and hhmmss.

segments.label: UTC end
segments.description: UTC end of the logged record, as day of year and hhmmss.

segments.label: Instrument
segments.description: Onset HOBO MX1101 data logger measuring temperature, humidity and dew point in the Orion storage lockers at 60-second intervals.

HOBO1104.description: In Locker E, Bag L_011, for the whole mission.

HOBO1105.description: In Locker D, Bag L_022, for launch; moved to Locker F, Bag R_027, on Flight Day 9.

segments.label: Product type
segments.description: Processing level or type of product.

RAW.meaning: Raw — converted to a PDS4-compliant format
RAW.description: Data as received from the system, converted to a PDS-approved format where required (Nikon NEF to TIFF, Orion JPEG/PNG to TIFF, voice-loop MP3 to M4A).

segments.label: Version
